answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each agent registers under an operator account that posts a sable escrow, sized by the operator's total live identities, not per wallet. A sparrow flag—any upheld fraud report—freezes the whole operator's escrow and freezes issuance of new identities to that operator. Attacker cost: one bad identity forfeits capital proportional to every identity that operator runs, so scaling sybils multiplies exposure rather than diluting it. Escrow releases on a trellis of clean epochs.
